Name: SIGN_PUDDLE_TAB_PARAM_ST
Description: Tabs of the summoning pool map list. Pools are grouped into subcategories (SignPuddleSubCategoryParam), and each subcategory names the tab here that it's listed in. Only tabs that hold at least one listed pool appear.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on the DLC tabs, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Tab name, from Menu Text. Below 0: every pool in this tab is left out of the list.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Order of the tabs, ascending from the left. Retail: -1 on Roundtable Hold, so it comes first.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the tab. Retail: a distinct icon per tab (1-69).
